name: client-status
title: Client work status (draft)
for_each: select id,name from clients where not archived order by name

sections.title: Work and confirmed dates
sections.sql: select name,status,due_date,currency,fee from jobs where client_id=$1 order by due_date

sections.title: Records still needed
sections.sql: select j.name as job,r.name as requested,r.due_date from requests r join jobs j on j.id=r.job_id where j.client_id=$1 and r.received_on is null order by r.due_date

name: records-request
title: Request for client records (draft)
for_each: select id,name from clients where not archived order by name

sections.title: Please provide these records
sections.sql: select j.name as job,r.name as requested,r.due_date from requests r join jobs j on j.id=r.job_id where j.client_id=$1 and r.received_on is null order by r.due_date

name: service-record
title: Service completion record (draft)
for_each: select id,name from clients where not archived order by name

sections.title: Services, outcomes and evidence
sections.sql: select name,status,completed_on,outcome,evidence_ref,retain_until from jobs where client_id=$1 order by completed_on

sections.title: Recorded advice and conversations
sections.sql: select j.name as job,n.kind,n.name as detail,n.actor,n.created_at from notes n join jobs j on j.id=n.job_id where j.client_id=$1 order by n.created_at
